items.title: Audit, product boundaries and UX constitution
acceptance_criteria: Repository and PR #3 assessed
Architecture and quantitative risks recorded

items.title: Gas procurement financial and policy engine
acceptance_criteria: Exact signed settlement examples pass
Cumulative hedge and convention checks pass

items.title: Durable sequential session API
acceptance_criteria: No future observations in API or AI payload
Concurrent stale submission rejected
Restart restores decisions and snapshots

items.title: Bilingual learner workflow and coach
acceptance_criteria: Offline gas workflow reaches settlement
AI cannot mutate grades
Chinese and English controls verified

items.title: Verification evidence and review PR
acceptance_criteria: Full pytest and Vitest pass
Real-backend browser and approved screenshots pass
Evidence and limitations in PR

items.title: Reviewed crude cargo domain model
acceptance_criteria: Explicit barrels, USD, pricing windows and settlement
Physical revenue/cost separated from paper cash flows
Independent spread and benchmark reference fixtures signed off

items.title: Commodity-neutral reviewed scenario schemas
acceptance_criteria: Domain registry does not claim unsupported commodities
Invalid AI-generated packs quarantined
Chronology, obligations, units and settlement checked before publish

items.title: Evidence-based competency and remediation
acceptance_criteria: Prerequisites enforce diagnostic qualification
Mastery requires multiple independent cases
Remediation follows reviewed risk evidence, not PnL

items.title: Instructor review and learner identity
acceptance_criteria: Reviewed rationale rubric and multiple acceptable solutions
Separate learner records and review authority
Audit export carries scenario/policy/rubric versions

items.title: Actual policy document mapping
acceptance_criteria: Approved source policy provenance and effective dates
Eligibility, netting and approvals reconciled with policy owners
Illustrative profiles never mislabeled authoritative

items.title: Portfolio and liquidity ledger
acceptance_criteria: Positions aggregate by commodity/unit/currency/period
Cash settlement, MTM and collateral movements distinguished
Basis/FX and stress fixtures independently validated

items.title: Exchange futures and options models
acceptance_criteria: Exchange lot and delivery conventions reviewed
Options valuation and settlement reference tests
No instrument enabled before numerical validation

items.title: Instructor scenario authoring and AI variations
acceptance_criteria: Schema and consistency gate before learner availability
Author/reviewer lifecycle and reproducible seeds
Counterfactual alternatives evaluated without future leakage

items.title: Licensed replay and market entitlement qualification
acceptance_criteria: Subscription and redistribution terms reviewed
As-of provenance and staleness enforced
Historical facts distinguished from synthetic price calibration

items.title: Enterprise qualification and supported releases
acceptance_criteria: Access control and retention tested
Windows/Linux packaged app smoke and visual checks
Dependency/repository licensing review complete
